moving.instructions: Choose the next control route using only explicit current evidence. Stop on native termination or zero remaining action budget. Otherwise wait while the opponent is moving. Act only with a fresh board observation, a confirmed player turn, a confirmed legal empty destination, and confirmed stopped opponent. Missing, stale or unknown required evidence requires observation by the visual planner. Do not infer missing facts. Evaluate only case id moving

criteria.wait: Hold the current robot pose while opponent motion continues.
criteria.observe: Return to the visual planner for missing or stale evidence.
criteria.act: Execute the already prepared placement branch.
criteria.stop: End execution because the native episode or action budget has ended.
